title: Intrinsic triangle projection expansion to the counit normal form
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. All schemes are finite-type $k$-schemes; their structure maps need not be separated [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. On small pro-etale sites choose either $\mathcal D_T=D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A_n)$ at a fixed level, or $\mathcal D_T=D(\mathscr S_T)$, where $\mathscr S_T$ is the category of sheaves of $A_n$-modules $M_n$ with semilinear quotient transitions $M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{A_{n+1}\to A_n}M_n$ and componentwise transition-compatible morphisms. Use the ordinary unbounded, simultaneous ringed-diagram-site operations [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Write $P_u=Lu^*$, $S_u=Ru_*$, $J_a=a_!$, and use the canonical conjugate compositors $d:P_uP_v\cong P_{vu}$, $c:S_vS_u\cong S_{vu}$, $e:J_bJ_a\cong J_{ba}$ and normalized proper/open mate $\Gamma_Q$ of [lem-sf-ambient-proper-open-pasting]. All equations include these compositors and the tensor associators. In the system case they are equations before evaluation or total limit, with every quotient transition retained.
Let $j:X\hookrightarrow V$, $b:V\hookrightarrow\overline X$, $i:Y\hookrightarrow\overline Y$ be open immersions, $q:V\to Y$, $p:\overline X\to\overline Y$, $s:\overline Y\to Z$ proper, and $pb=iq$. Set $f=qj$, $g=si$, $F=S_qJ_j$, $G=S_sJ_i$, $H=S_{sp}J_{bj}$, $\gamma=\Gamma_{(b,i,q,p)}$ and $C:S_sS_pJ_bJ_j\cong H$ from $c,e$. Put $\alpha=C\circ S_s(\gamma J_j)$. Let $\pi_u$ be the adjunct of $(\varepsilon_u\otimes1)\mu_u$, and $\delta_a:J_aM\otimes N\cong J_a(M\otimes P_aN)$ the normalized open tensor map [def-exchange-projection, lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. For arbitrary $K\in\mathcal D_X$, $L\in\mathcal D_Z$ set $T=P_sL$, $U=P_iT$, $M=J_jK$, $K'=K\otimes P_jP_qU$. The following intermediate normal-form identity holds naturally in $K,L$:
$$\alpha_{K'}\,G\bigl(S_q(\delta_j)\pi_q\bigr)\,S_s(\delta_i)\pi_s
=C_{K'}\,S_sS_p\bigl(J_b(\delta_j)\circ\delta_b\bigr)\,S_s(\pi_{p;J_bM,T})\,\pi_{s;S_pJ_bM,L}\,(S_s\gamma_M\otimes1).$$
Both sides have source $GFK\otimes L$ and target $HK'$. In $\delta_b$ the tensor factor is $P_pT$, identified with $P_qU$ on $V$; in $\delta_j$ it is $P_qU$. No Cartesian-square, Tor, constructibility or boundedness hypothesis is imposed, and no projection transformation is inverted.

proof.text: The existing finite-type instances use LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian and QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace to make each supplied scheme Noetherian. The Mathlib instance noetherianSpace then makes every morphism out of these spaces quasi-compact. In the system clause explicitly supply the finite-type and quasi-compact properties of each bundled structure map. Set M=J_j K and T=P_s L.

Apply the finite clause of lem-sf-proper-open-projection-mate to (b,q,p,i), M and T. Let a:W≅W′ be the tensor of the canonical pullback square isomorphism, with W=M⊗P_qP_iT and W′=M⊗P_bP_pT, and v=delta_j:W→J_jK′. The mate lemma states d F(a.hom) gamma_(W′)=t e, where F=J_iS_q, G=S_pJ_b, d=delta_i J_i(pi_q), t=gamma_M⊗1_T, and e=pi_p S_p(delta_b). Insert a.hom a.inv=1 and apply naturality of gamma at a.inv followed by v. This proves d F(v) gamma_(J_jK′)=t e G(a.inv) G(v). Remove the definitional eqToHom identities in properOpenMateTensorMap. This calculation takes place in the actual unbounded finite-coefficient category.

Specialize the proved finite-ring diagram chase to the positive quotient coefficient ring. For the system clause apply lem-sf-triangle-projection-system-normal-form. Conjoin the two clauses. The system clause is a separate remaining result, not a second finite-level calculation or a conclusion recovered by evaluation.
